ask.name: ask

parameters.description: What to ask, in plain language -- for example 'distance from Earth to Mars' or 'integrate x^2 dx'.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Optional. Which measurement system to answer in. Defaults to whatever Wolfram|Alpha infers from the question.
parameters.name: units

answer.description: The headline answer, taken from the section Wolfram|Alpha marks as the primary result

pods.description: Every result section, in the order Wolfram|Alpha returns them. The first restates the question.

pod_id.description: Wolfram's stable identifier for the section, for example 'Result'

primary.description: Whether Wolfram marked this as the section that answers the question

text.description: The section's plain-text content, with one line per sub-result

title.description: The section's heading, for example 'Result' or 'Unit conversions'

get_short_answer.description: Ask Wolfram|Alpha a question and get a single short answer, such as '2464 miles'.
get_short_answer.name: get_short_answer

parameters.description: What to ask, in plain language -- for example 'distance from Earth to Mars' or 'integrate x^2 dx'.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Optional. Which measurement system to answer in. Defaults to whatever Wolfram|Alpha infers from the question.
parameters.name: units

answer.description: The short answer, as a single line of plain text

get_spoken_answer.description: Ask Wolfram|Alpha a question and get the answer phrased as a full sentence, suited to reading aloud or sending as a notification.

parameters.description: What to ask, in plain language -- for example 'distance from Earth to Mars' or 'integrate x^2 dx'.
